notes.title: Seeker: My Shadow - Voice-over Narrative Update!
notes.content:
Greetings, adventurers!

We're thrilled to announce an exciting update for the story of Seeker: My Shadow, just in time for the upcoming Steam VR Fest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37677781/5b8be1cad780bcbad6cfcd044ea9fbead67bb390.png[/img]

This update includes minor fixes for the levels, but the highlight is the addition of a narrative voice-over for all levels! Delve into Viktor's thoughts during his journey, unraveling what he's going through in his mind and discovering why he initially sealed the gate to the Abyss.

Intriguingly, some mysterious notes have appeared in the cottage. These letters feature an enigmatic language. Can you translate the text and uncover Viktor's "goodbye note" for Ive?

We invite you to dive into the game and share your experience. Your reviews for Seeker: My Shadow make a significant impact, helping others discover and enjoy the game too.

P.S. Don't miss out on our Seeker: My Shadow PSVR 2 boxes giveaway! Head over to our [url=https://discord.gg/Cb9hY8y]Discord[/url] & [url=https://www.instagram.com/jestercraft/]Instagram[/url] for a chance to win. Join the competition in the selected channel(s), and there's still time to snag the box before Christmas! :)

Best regards,
Klaus, The Jester
[url=https://jestercraft.com/]Jestercraft Homepage[/url]

notes.title: Seeker: My Shadow Release Date Announcement
notes.content:
Greetings fellow VR players!

Now we have an official release date to announce! 

[h3]Seeker: My Shadow will be available on August 12th 2021[/h3]

Hop into our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1253930/Seeker_My_Shadow/]store page[/url] to see the Release Date Announcement Trailer! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1253930/Seeker_My_Shadow/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1253930/Seeker_My_Shadow/[/url]

The release version will feature:
- 20 Puzzle levels
- Support for local co-op
- Steam Remote Play support for online co-op
- Controller support
- Rich and crazy story
- Localization support for multiple languages (Russian, French, German, Portuguese, Finnish...)
- 100% family friendly gameplay

We've built Seeker: My Shadow from start to finish with the thought that we want it to be applicable for players of all ages. Now when we're soon the get it complete, we can say that it's not only good for all ages, but also suits very good as the first VR experience for younger gamers. 

We hope you like the announcement trailer (find it from our store page) and even more, the game itself when we go live!

PS: We will be taking down the demo rather soon, go ahead and try it out!

Love to the craft,
Team Jestercraft

notes.title: Steam Next Fest Demo Update: Patch notes!
notes.content:
Hi!

Patch notes for our Steam Next Fest major demo update:

[b]New features[/b]
[list]
[*] Localization: English and Finnish (language can be changed in the Cottage)
[*] Added a brand new level progress lock: In order to unlock the last demo level, you need to find a required amount of hidded eggs in previous levels.
[*] Added some in-game tutorial icons for basic controls. Detailed controls for VR can also be found in the VR menu.
[*] Lots of named NPCs with dialogue and wild Seekers scattered around the levels.
[*] NPC Interact system: When Kippo gets close to a NPC, an exclamation mark will indicate that they have some dialogue. Once the Interact symbol turns green and the player presses Interact, the dialogue will start.
[*] Updated dialogue system for co-op: Both players have control over dialogue speech bubbles shown to them, and can be progressed/skipped with the interact button. (Grip for VR, Space for keyboard, A/X or equivalent for controllers). The events after a dialogue will proceed when both players have progressed their dialogue to the end.
[*] Emotes for co-op: Kippo will howl and Spirit will roar with the Interact button.
[*] Added an audio fader in between levels.
[*] Added a Play button in the Cottage. A level can be started from that button or the Level Book.
[*] Added a Seeker Star object in the end of each level to better indicate the goal for Kippo.
[/list]

[b]Fixes and tweaks[/b]
[list]
[*] Updated default controls for VR. Detailed explanation can be found in the VR menu.
[*] Fixed audio not pausing when opening Steam VR menu.
[*] Many bug fixes & lots of visual additions in various levels.
[/list]


We hope you enjoy Steam Next Fest and Seeker: My Shadow demo content. Have fun and keep the feedback coming!

- The Jestercraft crew

notes.title: Closed beta signup and new content
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We have set up a closed beta for Seeker: My Shadow. You can sign up for the beta on the website https://www.jestercraft.com/my-shadow-subscribe?lang=en and we will get back to you.

For beta testers old and new, there's some new content to try out:

- Six (!) levels with their own puzzles and collectibles.
- Two tutorial levels with a brand new dialog system in the first one.
- New artwork for collectible Seeker Cards, unique for each level.
- New game manager for saving your progress and collectibles. However in this build all levels are unlocked at start so you can jump right into your favorite one.
- A round of polish on The Beginning, Forest, Garden and Roadblock levels


There is still work to be done with the current content, and that's why it is in closed beta. Of course there is also a lot more to come. We greatly appreciate anyone checking out the game at this stage and testing it out. Feel free to send us some feedback through the in-game feedback form or through our social media channels. 

Have fun!

notes.title: My Shadow | Steam Game Festival Quick Pitch
notes.content:
[h2][b]Jump in the story of My Shadow![/b][/h2]


My Shadow is a co-op/single player virtual reality game, where VR puzzle solving and top-down movement is combined. You play as Spirit, the mountain-sized god, and your mission is to help the small and cute Seeker through various casual puzzle levels in calm and magical environments.

Experience and explore the story solving casual yet challenging puzzles as a single player, or with your friend as asymmetrical or online co-op. Escort your friend Seeker to safety and guide it on its journey.

The puzzles feature a combination of top-down character movement (as the PC player) and hands-on puzzle-solving (as the VR player). In VR single player mode, you’re able to control both of the characters. Solve the puzzles by investigating for clues and interacting with the surroundings in VR and help the little Seeker to overcome its obstacles on its journey.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Steam Game Festival Summer Edition: June 16 - June 22

Note: the demo is still in early stage and under development, it may be different from the final game. 

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Join our [url=https://discord.gg/rxk3r9J]Discord [/url]to help us develop the game! ːsteamhappyː
